originalTitle: World Bank's IFC, HDFC AMC invest in Molbio Diagnostics' Rs 281 crore IPO anchor round
simplifiedContent: Molbio Diagnostics, a company based in Goa, is planning to raise money by selling shares to the public, known as an Initial Public Offering (IPO). Before the IPO starts on August 10, the company has already raised Rs 281 crore from some big investors, including the World Bank's IFC and HDFC Mutual Fund. This is called an "anchor round" and it's a good sign for the company. The company will try to raise a total of Rs 940 crore from its IPO, and some big investment firms are recommending that people buy shares, which is a positive signal. This investment from big names may help build confidence in the company's IPO.

originalTitle: Market Trading Guide: Jindal Saw among 2 stock recommendations for Monday
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening in the stock market: some companies in India have recently reported their earnings, which is the money they made. Most of these companies did as well as or better than people thought they would, which is good news. Because of this, some experts are feeling positive about certain areas of the market, like the sector that Jindal Saw is in. This is why Jindal Saw is being recommended as a stock to consider buying on Monday, along with one other stock. This recommendation is based on the idea that the company's sector is doing well, which could help its stock price go up.

originalTitle: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide D-Street action on Monday
simplifiedContent: The Indian stock market had a bad day on Friday, with two important indexes, Sensex and Nifty, both falling. Sensex fell by 456 points, while Nifty fell by 65 points. This happened because of worries about problems in the Middle East and changes in oil prices, which made investors a bit nervous. However, good news from a big bank called SBI helped make investors feel a little better about the banking sector. This uncertainty will likely affect what happens in the market on Monday.

originalTitle: The stock market is finally rising again—and it’s getting cheaper, too
simplifiedContent: The stock market, which is like a big place where people buy and sell pieces of companies, is doing better now. A specific group of big companies, called the S&P 500, has seen its value go up by 22% over the past year. Even though the value is up, the "valuation" (or price) of these companies has actually gone down, which means they might be a better deal for buyers now. This is a positive sign for investors, as it could make it a more affordable time to invest in the market. It's a good thing for people who want to invest, as it might be a good time to buy into the market.

originalTitle: Upcoming IPOs: Shiprocket IPO, Dhoot Transmission IPO among new issues to open next week; full list here
simplifiedContent: Some companies, including Shiprocket and Dhoot Transmission, are planning to sell their shares to the public for the first time through an Initial Public Offering (IPO). This means people can buy their shares, hoping to make a profit if the company does well. These IPOs will start accepting money from investors between August 10 and 12. At the same time, eight other companies that recently sold their shares will start trading on the market, allowing people to buy and sell them freely. This is important because it gives investors new opportunities to put their money into different companies.

originalTitle: Defence stock Apollo Micro Systems declares Q1 results 2026. Revenue jumps 88% YoY to  ₹251 crore, PAT up 43%
simplifiedContent: Apollo Micro Systems, a company that makes parts for the defense industry, just released its financial results for the first quarter of 2026. The company's revenue, or the amount of money it made from selling its products, increased by 88% compared to the same time last year, reaching ₹251 crore. Its profit, which is the amount of money it made after paying its expenses, increased by 43% to ₹25.2 crore. This means the company is doing better than it was last year, which is a positive sign for investors. This increase in revenue and profit is important because it shows that the company is growing and performing well.
